chief_data.selection_justification: Selected because it meets the intensification mandate with a 15x residence-time reduction and enhanced laminar mixing, while maintaining acceptable safety and productivity. Warning: no concrete flow advantage identified. This design may not justify flow over batch.
chief_data.selection_rationale: Candidate 4 was selected with a combined score of 0.725, driven by its ability to meet the intensification mandate of a 15x residence-time reduction and enhanced laminar mixing. It also maintains a good balance of safety and productivity. Candidate 3, with a higher productivity, was held back by its high pressure drop and lower safety score. Candidate 2, while having a good productivity score, did not meet the required residence-time reduction. The user objective of balanced performance influenced the decision, prioritizing safety and mixing over pure productivity. The most important remaining uncertainties are the actual flow enhancement factor and the photon delivery efficiency. The first experiment should verify the residence time and mixing efficiency under flow conditions.
resolved_tradeoffs: id=4 vs id=3: id=4 has a lower pressure drop (0.981 bar vs 33.321 bar) and better safety score (0.700 vs 0.600).
id=4 vs id=2: id=4 meets the 15x residence-time reduction mandate, whereas id=2 does not.
remaining_uncertainties: Flow enhancement factor of 15x is assumed but not experimentally verified.
Photon delivery efficiency in the selected ID is not yet confirmed.
chief_data.experiment_recommendation: Run blank solvent at design Q for 30 min, then switch to reaction mixture. Sample at t=3τ and t=5τ.
